lore_anchors.definition: A one-use assassination treasure of terrifying power, capable of piercing most protective techniques and treasures; designed to kill Immortals.
A one-use, extremely expensive formation that completely seals off a region, costing a million jin of Primordial Liquid; very difficult to break through quickly.
A separate soul-body cultivated by a Primal Daoist, capable of independent cultivation and combat; often kept hidden as a trump card.
A set of nine powerful Heaven-ranked flying swords that serve as the core of Ji Ning’s sword formation, dramatically amplifying its might.
A top-ten divine ability of the Three Realms, created by Daoist Threelives; training it strengthens the hands beyond normal treasure grade, granting terrifying physical striking power.
A Fiendgod Divine Ability that allows the cultivator to grow extra heads and arms, exponentially increasing their offensive and defensive capabilities in close combat.
A divine ability that allows the cultivator to emulate the size and mass of the cosmos itself; strictly not to be translated as 'gigantification.'
The fifth major realm of Ki Refining, where the cultivator’s soul transforms into a Primal (Yuanshen), enabling the creation of a Primaltwin and the use of Divine Sense.
The sixth major realm of Ki Refining, a stage before Heavenly Tribulation; these cultivators are considered pseudo-Immortals with great power but limited lifespan.
A cultivator who survived a failed Heavenly Tribulation by abandoning their physical body; they have immense power but face recurring, escalating tribulations that eventually claim them.
Specially inscribed armor that allows multiple soldiers to merge their power into a single entity, dramatically enhancing their combined combat effectiveness.
A high-level manifestation of Dao comprehension where the cultivator projects their understanding of the Dao as a persistent field of influence, amplifying their techniques.
